description: The file defines a PHP class KpiAPI within the namespace OrangeHRM\'Performance\Api'. It implements CRUD endpoints for managing KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) in a Human Resource Management system, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting KPI records. It also includes validation rules and documentation annotations for API specifications.

classes.name: KpiAPI
classes.description: A class implementing REST API endpoints for managing KPI entities, including retrieve, list, create, update, and delete operations, with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific KPI by ID, returning its data and editability status.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of KPIs, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new KPI entity with provided data.

methods.name: setKpi
methods.description: Helper method to populate a Kpi object from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a KPI.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Shared validation rules for KPI creation and update requests.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing KPI record after validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a KPI.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple KPIs specified in the request.
